verdict.rationale: Vestd is a SaaS equity-management platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no such spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file and the HRIS integration are adjacent features, not a downloadable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
